scope.notes: Inventory in progress (79 rows). Covers Exalted: The Lunars core innate powers (Lunar Shapechanging, the Tell, True Forms, Caste Mark tattooing/Fixing the Caste, Casteless consequences), the full Shapechanging I/II/III Charm trees (with the Deadly Beastman Transformation gift table), the full Body Enhancement I/II Charm trees, and the full Unarmed Combat I through V Charm trees plus three further Body Weapon Technique-rooted utility Charms (Door-Breaking Method, Hunter's Eye Technique, Armor-Rending Claw Fist) -- completing the entire Unarmed Combat Charm category. Melee Combat, Ranged Combat, Defensive, Survival and Healing, Perception, Stealth, Presence/social, Spirit, and Sorcery-access Charms (roughly pp. 149-193/PDF 152-196), plus Backgrounds, Merits/Flaws, caste/tribe creation options, and supplements, are not yet inventoried.

sources.role: Primary Lunar rules, Charms, Backgrounds, Merits/Flaws, and setting material

rulesNotes: Printed page numbers in this book run 3 less than the PDF page number supplied (PDF page = printed page + 3) for the copy used to build this inventory; both are recorded on every citation.
Lunar Charms use Minimum Attribute (not Minimum Ability) fields, per p. 122 (PDF 125).

A handful of rows in the Unarmed Combat III-V trees have book text that reads awkwardly around botch/infection resolution (Rabid Beast Bite, Grasping Pseudopod Method); paraphrased faithfully but flagged in each row's notes for a closer re-read before promotion. Armor-Rending Claw Fist's mechanics also cut off mid-sentence at the bottom of its rendered page and needs the following page reviewed to complete it.
